```{=typst}
#grid(
  columns: (2.8cm, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 0.3cm,
  [],
  [
    #text(weight: "bold", size: 22pt, fill: rgb("#BC1E22"), font: "Inter")[CHARTE GRAPHIQUE]
    #v(0.05cm)
    #text(size: 11pt, font: "Inter")[*Saga Star Wars* — charte graphique pour l'atelier RR 2026]
  ],
)

#v(0.4cm)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#0B0B0F"))
#v(0.1cm)
```

## Palette

```{=typst}
#let swatch(name, hex) = box(width: 4.2cm)[
  #rect(fill: rgb(hex), width: 100%, height: 1.4cm, radius: 2pt, stroke: 0.3pt + rgb("#0B0B0F"))
  #v(-0.2cm)
  #text(size: 9pt, font: "Inter")[
    #raw(name) \
    #raw(hex)
  ]
]

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 0.3cm,
  swatch("imperial-red", "#BC1E22"),
  swatch("sw-black", "#0B0B0F"),
  swatch("sw-cream", "#F5F0E1"),
  swatch("sw-yellow", "#FFE81F"),
)
```

**Affectations** &nbsp;·&nbsp; `primary: imperial-red` &nbsp;·&nbsp; `foreground: sw-black` &nbsp;·&nbsp; `background: sw-cream`

*Affectations = rôles sémantiques associés à un nom de la palette. `sw-yellow` reste dans la palette (utile pour accents ponctuels) — mais pas en `primary` (contraste trop faible sur fond crème).*

## Typographie

```{=typst}
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 0.8cm,
  [
    #text(font: "Star Jedi", size: 18pt, fill: rgb("#BC1E22"))[THE SAGA AWAKENS]
    #v(0.2cm)
    #text(size: 10pt, font: "Inter")[
      *Star Jedi* — locale \
      Fichier : `_fonts/Starjedi.ttf` \
      Usage : `typography.headings`
    ]
  ],
  [
    #text(font: "Inter", size: 13pt)[
      Anatomie d'une saga : qui sont les colosses de la galaxie ? Le dataset `dplyr::starwars` recense 87 personnages.
    ]
    #v(0.2cm)
    #text(size: 10pt, font: "Inter")[
      *Inter* — Google Fonts \
      Source : `google` (poids 400, 600) \
      Usage : `typography.base`
    ]
  ],
)
```

## Logo

```{=typst}
#grid(
  columns: (3cm, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 0.8cm,
  align(center + horizon)[#image("_logo-sw.svg", width: 2.5cm)],
  [
    #v(0.3cm)
    #text(size: 10pt, font: "Inter")[
      Fichier : `_logo-sw.svg` (étoile jaune, contour noir) \
      Alt-text : `"Étoile jaune Star Wars"` \
      Usage : `logo.images.sw-star` → `logo.medium`
    ]
  ],
)
```

]
